assessment: This work that presents in great experimental detail how short chain fatty acids produced by gut microbiota interact with the short chain fatty acids receptors FFA2 and FFA3 significantly extends previous findings of your group in particular by identifying a new agonist for FFA2 but also because of the techniques you have used to achieve your results. In particular, that this study relies on a state of the art chemogenetics approach allows you to perform a rigorous validation of the receptor agonists you identified. You have also in your revised manuscript addressed the major concerns that were raised by the reviewers in the previous round of reviews and we believe this paper will have a significant impact in the field.
